scope: secret scanning of worktree and git history
sql injection and ssrf candidate review

findings.evidence: Trivy DS-0002: Image user should not be root
findings.impact: A compromise of nginx runs with unnecessary container privileges.
findings.remediation: Use an unprivileged nginx image or configure port, pid, cache and temporary directories for a non-root USER; update Compose and health checks together.

findings.impact: Mutable action tags can resolve to unreviewed code.
findings.remediation: Pin actions to audited full commit SHAs and automate reviewed updates.

findings.impact: Untrusted multimodal contexts may trigger SSRF or local file reads.
findings.remediation: Keep Ragas out of production, use it only in an isolated offline evaluation environment, and upgrade or remove it when a complete upstream fix exists.

findings.location: backend/rag and backend/services raw SQL call sites
findings.evidence: 12 Semgrep ERROR candidates and 11 Bandit B608 candidates
findings.impact: Future changes could introduce injection if untrusted values reach SQL structure.
findings.remediation: Retain parameter binding and identifier allowlists; add focused tests whenever query composition changes.

findings.evidence: Base image tags are not pinned to digests; Compose lacks uniform runtime hardening controls.
findings.impact: Build inputs can drift and compromised processes retain more runtime capability than necessary.
findings.remediation: Pin reviewed image digests and add service-specific no-new-privileges, capability and read-only filesystem controls.
